title: Podcast from a document
summary: Reads an AI Write document, turns it into a 250 to 400 word spoken script with the on-device model, and saves the script as a podcast episode. A fixed chain: no planner decides anything.
whenToUse: Use when the person wants to listen to something they already have in AI Write.

arguments.name: document
arguments.description: The document's id, or words from its title

example: Make a podcast from my document about local language models
